purpose: P01 documentation and P02 schema/inventory evidence. This file is not runtime content and must not be imported by the game.

statusDefinitions.verified: The narrowly stated field is supported by the cited source and its edition qualifier; evidenceLevel distinguishes manual from reference support. Not a cartridge observation or whole-system acceptance.
statusDefinitions.blocked: No executable default is authorized. value remains null; unverifiedContext is a research lead only.

regionPolicy: Each record retains its source region. The audit does not select a regional edition, prove regional equivalence, or add an edition selector.
sourcePolicy: Retain source locators and retrieval dates. Inherited sources are candidates only. Mirrors and potentially related wiki text are not counted as independent corroboration. No original program, script or assets are copied.
